posts.title: 161 Years of Irish Rain, in One Dashboard
posts.description: An interactive dashboard for Met Éireann's Long-term Island of Ireland Precipitation network — 25 stations, 1850 to 2010, mapped, charted, and change-point detected.

posts.title: Colour Wheel for Oil Painters
